notes: Dev RBox expansion, paired with mathematics-replace-d006: a made-up relation, thessarine_to, is given the property the revision gives parallel_to (asymmetry), so revision and expansion send the model to the same conclusions and differ only in whether symmetry had to be pushed out. The instances use real lines (the x-axis, the y-axis, the line y = 2). 'Thessarine' is a coined adjective with no built-in direction or mutuality (0 hits in Dolma, none on Wikipedia). Yes and no are balanced: direct (yes), the converse asked as 'Could the y-axis also be thessarine to the x-axis?' (no; 'does it follow' would be 'no' for any made-up relation), and whether it is ruled out (yes). The cross-lingual prompts ask the first instance and keep the coined word untranslated. Unrelated near asks, as an instance, whether one perpendicular line rules out the converse (it does not, since 'is perpendicular to' is symmetric): an editor that spreads asymmetry to other line relations answers yes. Unrelated far asks a symmetric instance (siblings).
